sidecar_purpose: Repo-resident template sidecar for a four-column, twelve-equal-panel asset sheet. Supports template selection, layout planning, and QA of grid-based sheets.
source_truth_note: This sidecar is derived visual evidence for the referenced image. The repo image bytes and package manifest remain authoritative for custody; this sidecar does not authorize derivative images or broaden canon.

summary: Candidate template for a four-column, twelve-equal-panel asset sheet. The header has metadata columns, and the main area is a 4x3 grid of equal cells. A footer provides guidance and continuity notes.

composition: Landscape template with dark green border and cream/white field.
Header reads 'ASSET SHEET' with TITLE, TYPE, STATUS, VERSION, SOURCE/QA columns.
Metadata: TITLE '4 Column 12 Equal', TYPE 'Grid / reference sheet', STATUS 'candidate', VERSION 'v1', SOURCE/QA 'GPT-authored template'.
Main area: 4 columns by 3 rows of equal panels, totalling 12 cells.
Each cell is the same size and has a placeholder label.
guidance_notes: Use for a uniform grid of assets, expressions, props, or poses where all cells have equal weight.
Good for sets of 12 related items.

positive_constraints: Use this template for 12-item uniform grids.
Keep all 12 cells equal size and the 4x3 layout.
Maintain the metadata header and footer notes.
negative_constraints: Do not treat 'candidate' status as final accepted canon.
Do not add hero panels or break the equal-cell layout.
Do not use for fewer than 12 items without layout review.

best_for: QA of sheets built from this template.
not_sufficient_for: Final canon approval without sheet content and image QA.
Exact measurements; inspect the image pixels.
